You've been working on the issue associated with this worktree/branch. Now, Playwright e2e fail in dms-material-e2e (chromium). Fix them one at a time. Use serial sub-agents to keep your context small.

HARD RULE: never read or print an entire test log into your context. Full-suite logs are hundreds of KB and will overflow your context window and crash the run. All large output goes to files on disk; you only ever extract small slices (tail / grep) into context.

1. Baseline: run pnpm e2e:dms-material:chromium --reporter=list > /tmp/e2e-full.log 2>&1 with a generous timeout (up to ~45 min). Do NOT read the whole file. Extract only the failed test names from Playwright's final summary section, e.g. tail -n 120 /tmp/e2e-full.log
2. For each failing spec, re-run ONLY that file: pnpm nx run dms-material-e2e:e2e-chromium -- <spec-file> > /tmp/e2e-<name>.log 2>&1 (a single-spec run skips the storybook build, so it is much faster). Read only the tail of that log (tail -n 150) to get the error details.
3. Fix ONE failure at a time. Prefer fixing application code; change a test only when the test itself is wrong or flaky (for settle delays use the existing settle() helper in apps/dms-material-e2e/src/helpers/settle.helper.ts). Do not weaken assertions, do not add .skip(), do not delete tests.
4. Verify by re-running that single spec until it passes, then move to the next failing spec. Repeat until every previously failing spec passes individually.
5. Final gate: run pnpm e2e:dms-material:chromium --reporter=list > /tmp/e2e-final.log 2>&1 and check only its tail/summary for a clean pass. If it still fails, repeat the loop from step 2 with the new failures.
6. Stop when the full suite passes, or when you can make no further progress; end with a short plain-text summary of what was fixed and anything left failing.
